title: Beautiful Colors of Hawaii Photo Tour
includes: Pick-up and drop-off at select area hotels
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children must be accompanied by an adult
Involves a small amount of walking
Operates rain or shine; dress appropriately
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
You have to see the real colors of Hawaii! Your Beautiful Hawaii Tour is a must-do adventure on Hawaii’s Windward coast! 

Your pick-up is at 9:00 am and returns at 2:00 pm. You're going on a journey with a small group to capture natural attractions, historical sights, and endless beaches offered by “the gathering place," Oahu! Our tour is designed to allow you plenty of time to explore and experience Hawaii. Visit sites most tourists will never see. 

Your guide is a great photographer, but that does not mean you need to be one too. Bring your camera and snap everlasting photos as you create memories of a lifetime! 

At this price, you can’t go wrong. Don’t settle for anything less. The views you will see put frank with kick butt!
